response.sql:
WITH playlist_counts AS (
  SELECT PlaylistId, COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM PlaylistTrack
  GROUP BY PlaylistId
),
with_average AS (
  SELECT PlaylistId, track_count,
         AVG(track_count) OVER () AS average_track_count
  FROM playlist_counts
)
SELECT PlaylistId AS playlist_id,
       track_count,
       CAST(track_count AS REAL) / average_track_count AS ratio
FROM with_average
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The ratio is calculated using the average count across playlists with at least one PlaylistTrack entry, as specified; numeric division is used to avoid integer truncation.
